sn22.157:1.1: Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kim upādāya kim abhinivissa uppajjanti saññojanābhinivesavinibandhāti || || Bhagavammūlakā no bhante dhammā || pe || || Rūpe kho bhikkhave sati rūpam upādāya rūpaṃ abhinivissa uppajjanti saññojanābhinivesavinibandhā || || Vedanāya sati || Saññāya sati || Saṅkhāresu sati || Viññāṇe sati viññāṇam upādāya viññāṇam abhinivissa uppajjanti saññojanābhinivesavinibandhā || || Taṃ kim maññatha bhikkhave Rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || || Aniccam bhante || || Yam panāniccam || pa || api nu tam anupādāya uppajjeyyuṃ saññojanābhinivesavinibandhā ti || || No hetam bhante || || Vedanā
